question: What physical use of the written armor is prescribed for the practitioner?
premises: The armor may be written on birch bark
It may be made into an amulet placed in gold
One may wear it if so prepared
inference: If written on birch bark and placed in gold as an amulet, one may wear it.
plain_english: If one writes it on birch bark, makes it into an amulet placed in gold, one may wear it.
